description: This Java class provides helper methods for handling variable installment plans, loan product creation, loan application process, and variations in loan schedules within integration tests for the Fineract project. It includes methods to create various loan product configurations, generate JSON payloads for modifying repayment schedules, and utility functions for date formatting and constructing test data.

classes.name: VariableInstallmentsDecliningBalanceHelper
classes.description: Helper class providing methods to create various loan products, applications, and schedule variations for integration testing of variable installment features in Fineract.
